name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The colonist from Ganymede's distance is between Eklund and the Navigator.
Eklund's distance is lower than both the Engineer and the colonist from Callisto.
Pilot goes with exactly two of Eklund, Callisto, and 12 ly.
Cho, 11 ly, and 12 ly go with Callisto, Earth, and Luna, in some order.
Exactly one of these is true: Cho goes with Engineer; Eklund goes with Ganymede; Earth goes with 12 ly.
Either Ganymede goes with 12 ly or Rios goes with Geologist.
